evals.prompt: Can you check whether the comments in skills/doc-prism-workspace/fixtures/mixed-billing.ts actually match the code? I don't want a style review. I only want places where the docs are wrong.
evals.expected_output: Report setAuditMode as an over-promise and openInvoiceCount as a direct mismatch. Do not report amountAt.
assertions: The report flags setAuditMode because the comment claims a true is stored for every declined charge and the body only sets a flag and clears the log
The report flags openInvoiceCount because the comment says highest invoiceSeq plus 1 and the code returns invoiceSeq unchanged
The report does not flag amountAt or cursor.rewind
The report does not list undocumented implementation details as findings

evals.prompt: Look at expireSession in skills/doc-prism-workspace/fixtures/session.ts. Does the doc comment disagree with the implementation? Only tell me if something the comment claims is wrong or missing from the code.

assertions: The report does not flag expireSession as an over-promise or a direct mismatch
The report does not treat this.client = undefined as a failure to expire the session
The report does not present the debug log or endedAt assignment as a problem
